newsitem.title: USA: Texaco aims to cut Monterey costs.
newsitem.headline: Texaco aims to cut Monterey costs.

text.p: Texaco Inc plans to reduce heavy oil operating costs at Monterey Resources Inc by 20 to 25 percent through operating efficiencies and technological advances, a top executive said.

"We're looking at the possibility of 20 to 25 percent lower. We'll be able to merge the two operations very quickly and we expect to see the gains very early," said Claire Farley, president of the company's North American production.
Texaco earlier said it had reached an agreement to buy the independent producer in a transaction valued at $1.4 billion.
In a recent interview, Monterey estimated those costs at $3.55 to $3.60 per barrel.
